result.title: Geometric Morphology Learning: Empowering Foundation Models from Structure to Spacetime Intelligence
result.summary: Geometry is the very form that connects space, time, and matter, serving as the fundamental fabric of the physical world, from continuous fields to discrete structures. Despite its importance, deep learning is inherently blind to geometry. Riemannian geometry stands as a well-established mathematical foundation for studying geometry, yet it remains largely incompatible with deep learning architectures. To bridge this gap, we establish a new learning framework--Geometric Morphology Learning--that learns geometric or topological structures, shapes or conformations for representation learning, reasoning and action modeling. Moving beyond early attempts limited to specific geometric priors, this theory centers on modeling the intrinsic geometry of objects and learning from such geometric or topological knowledge. Specifically, we construct a neural bundle, a unified scaffolding linking local and global structures, and formulate differentiable operators, including connection and curvature, thereby enabling the study of geometry with advanced geometric concepts such as holonomy and cohomology. Consequently, Geometric Morphology Learning opens new horizons in foundation models, reasoning and planning, graph modeling, physical simulation, PDE systems, and dynamics, marking a fundamental shift toward instilling systematic geometry in artificial intelligence.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出「几何形态学习」框架，主张把内在几何与拓扑结构纳入表示学习、推理与动作建模，通过 neural bundle 统一局部与全局结构，并定义可微的连接与曲率算子以支持 holonomy、上同调等概念。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是一篇偏愿景的理论框架文，未涉及视觉推理；但其可微连接/曲率等工具或可为刻画 latent 状态的表示几何、解释 latent 相似度中的内容与位置结构提供形式化线索，值得核查其可操作性。
